notes: Chess Trainer v5.0: the Learn tab becomes a real library. Endgame Practice: 15 canonical endings — queen, rook, pawn and bishop endings, rook + pawn vs rook, the Philidor and Vancura defences — played against the engine's best defence, with a coach Hint and a Solved tick for every ending you convert or hold. And 23 lessons in four sections: Getting Started (how every piece moves, castling, en passant, checkmate and stalemate — all on the board), Tactics (fork, pin, skewer, back-rank mate, discovered attack, deflection, hanging pieces — each with three guided puzzles), Opening Principles (checked against the engine's top choices) and Endgame Basics, which end by opening the matching endgame drill.
